数仓版集群ID。

description.en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to query cluster IDs.

descriptions.zh:
### 使用说明
该接口仅适用于数仓版弹性模式集群版（新版）。
descriptions.en: You can call this operation only for AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) clusters in elastic mode for Cluster Edition.
